# `silk/schema/wire`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

One reader and one writer type that every format of `silk.schema` goes through.

## When to use
Use `WireReader` or `WireWriter` when code that reads or writes a `Schema` type picks its format
at run time. `SchemaJson`, `SchemaToml`, `SchemaYaml` and `SchemaMsgpack` already read and write through them.

## Details
A derived `Schema.read` is compiled once for each reader type it is used with, and a derived
`Schema.write` once for each writer type. Because the formats share these two types, a
type gets one reader and one writer however many formats a program uses. Each operation
forwards to the reader or writer of the format it holds, so what is read, written and reported
is that format's own.

Import as `WireReader` with `import silk.schema.wire { WireReader }`.
